Before you begin

Planning a kitchen in Tinley Park?

Do you have a showroom in Tinley Park?

Our showroom is in Chicago at 1200 W 37th St. This page helps you plan a visit from Tinley Park; it does not represent a separate local branch.

Can you deliver or install at my address?

Share your Tinley Park address, access requirements and project scope with the team to confirm availability, responsibilities and timing.

Are the project examples completed customer kitchens?

These are design concepts, with illustrative imagery and proposed cabinet arrangements. They are a starting point for your brief. Ask the team for available completed-project references.

Can I start before I have final measurements?

Yes. Start with room photos, approximate dimensions and your priorities. Final site measurements and specifications are required before approving an order.
